summary: @ornikar/kitt2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle script (`node setup.mjs`) auto-runs on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})` against a sibling file bundled in the tarball. The invoked file `math_init.js` (~728KB) is heavily obfuscated (string-array rotation via `WV8StW` push/shift rotator, large numeric constant tables, randomized hex-style identifiers such as `MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`, `JqTtnbZ`), and its name and content bear no relation to the package's advertised React/Tamagui component-library purpose in `dist/`. Using a freshly downloaded alternate runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload evades Node-based static analysis and is not a legitimate build step for a component library. The package name `@ornikar/kitt2` differs from the repository field pointing to `github.com/ornikar/kitt`, consistent with a lookalike or scope variant rather than the legitimate project.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
